correctness.rationale: The exact convergent pole formula follows from differentiating sinc and the Mittag--Leffler cotangent expansion. Every residue c_n=8−48/(nπ)² is strictly positive. Consequently Im R has strict sign off real w and R decreases strictly across each pole interval. The sinc poles, z=0 and the limiting τ=1 case are independently handled. The Taylor expansion gives exactly double zero at τ=5 and derivative/nonzero-root simplicity. The asymptotic follows from the hyperbolic cotangent form. `check.py` reproduces 12 independent integral and 44 spectral checks but is not used as an infinite proof.
